VTS Scoring Log

Biotech Peptides

US-based vendor (San Diego, CA) · Established operation· Scored August 2026· biotechpeptides.com

Biotech Peptides is an established San Diego-based vendor with a broad catalog of 87+ US-synthesized peptides. HPLC and mass spectrometry testing is documented. The gap that limits the score is the primary site's testing language - 'our analytical lab uses mass spectrometry' - which implies in-house rather than independent third-party testing. Third-party review sources describe batch-level COAs on product pages, but the primary site does not name an external testing laboratory. Buyers should request a COA and confirm which lab issued it.

59 /100

Scoring Notes
'Our analytical lab' - the key language gap
The About page states 'our analytical lab uses mass spectrometry to verify the theoretical molecular weight.' This describes Biotech Peptides' own analytical lab performing testing - not an independent third party. If Biotech Peptides uses a named external lab that is not prominently surfaced on the primary site, this score may understate their actual documentation practices. Buyers should request a COA and confirm which laboratory issued it.
Score may improve with direct COA review
If published COAs show a named independent laboratory - which some third-party reviewers describe - the Testing Practice and Traceability scores would increase meaningfully. This log is based on primary site language and will be updated if the documentation architecture is confirmed as third-party independent.
Established operation and catalog depth are genuine positives
Biotech Peptides is a long-operating vendor with a broad catalog and established community recognition. The Limited Transparency band reflects documentation architecture gaps from primary site evidence, not concerns about operational legitimacy.
